items.name: Beam Scan
items.description: Five spotlights hanging in a row swing their soft beams down onto a floor, crossing and fanning out.
items.notes: Reads as a lighting rig: the lamps sit in the upper third and the beams land in pools near the bottom edge, so it suits a wide Surface or a stage backdrop. The beams cross and splay over the loop without cuts. Mostly black, so it sits well in Additive over a slow ambient Layer, or under a Hit on the downbeat.

items.name: Black Sphere Rim
items.description: A black sphere in the centre, lit only by a rim of light that travels around its edge.
items.notes: Very dark and quiet: a thin crescent of light orbits a black disc, brightening in a slow pulse. Put it on a round or central Surface, or in Additive over a dark Layer, for breakdowns and intros. It carries little light on its own; pair it with a Hit or a Build when the track opens up.

items.name: Bar Rise
items.description: A grey bar rises from the bottom edge and brightens until the whole frame is white.
items.notes: A plain progress-bar riser: the lit area climbs from the bottom and grows brighter over 7.5 seconds, ending fully white. Start it so its last frame lands on the drop, then cut to a Hit or a Loop. On a tall Surface it reads as a level filling up; stack Scanlines or Pixel Crush over it for texture.

items.name: Riser Whiteout
items.description: A starburst of rays and expanding rings grows from the centre and ends in a full white frame.
items.notes: A riser in one shot: rays and rings multiply and speed up for 7.5 seconds while the centre swells, and the last frame is solid white. Time its end to the drop and cut to a Loop or a Hit. The whiteout lights the whole Surface, so it works as the peak of a Scene before a Blackout or a cut.

items.name: Chevron Rush
items.description: Stacks of white chevrons above and below a bright horizon rush toward the viewer, with streaks of light.
items.notes: A symmetric flight down a corridor of chevrons, with constant fast motion and no cuts. It fills the frame edge to edge, so it suits a large single Surface or a wall. Good under a verse that needs momentum; Punch Zoom or Impact Shake on the beat adds hits without another clip.

items.name: Chevron Slam
items.description: An upward chevron slams to full size on the beat and alternates with smaller chevrons and fading ghosts.
items.notes: Hard-edged and graphic: a thick white caret fills the frame on each accent and fades, with a small chevron holding the centre between hits. The loop opens on its biggest slam, so start it on a downbeat. Reads well on narrow or angular Surfaces; pairs with Chevron Rush for a section change.

items.name: Cross Uncross
items.description: Two thick white bars snap into an X and swing back to a single horizontal line.
items.notes: Minimal and rhythmic: the bars cross on the accents and ease back to flat between them. It uses little light, so several copies on different Surfaces read as one rig. Use it where the shape of the Surface should stay visible; in Additive over Beam Scan or Ray Wheel it gives the beat a hard line.

items.name: Dot Sequencer
items.description: A 3×3 grid of dim dots where one dot at a time flashes white and fades, stepping in a pattern.
items.notes: Reads as a step sequencer: nine grey dots stay visible and one lights per step. The grid sits in the middle third, so Fit Contain on a square Surface keeps it whole. Quiet enough for a breakdown; stack it over a slow ambient Layer so the dots count out the bar.

items.name: Fan Shafts
items.description: A four-blade fan turns in front of a bright light, chopping it into rotating shafts.
items.notes: Volumetric and bright: the fan sits left of centre and throws wide grey shafts across the frame as it turns. It lights most of the Surface, so it works as a base Layer rather than an accent. Good for industrial or tense sections; Scanlines or Dither over it keep the haze from reading flat.

items.name: Frame Tunnel
items.description: Nested square frames recede into a tunnel that twists and brightens in a slow swell.
items.notes: Mostly dim: the tunnel of square outlines rotates, flashes right after the loop starts, then swells to its brightest around the middle and fades again. It fits a square or centred Surface. Use it for builds inside a Scene, or in Additive under a Hit that lands on its bright middle.

items.name: Glitch Stutter
items.description: Rows of broken bars, blocks and scan lines stutter across the frame, with black frames between bursts.
items.notes: Data-corruption texture: horizontal bars and blocks jump, freeze and cut to black in an irregular rhythm, so the loop seam is invisible. It reads on any Surface shape. Use it for glitch sections or transitions; Block Glitch or Slice Shift over another Layer gives a similar feel without a clip.

items.name: Bass Shockwave
items.description: A bright core bursts into an expanding ring with radial spikes over a warped grid, and fades in about a second.
items.notes: A one-shot for a bass drop or a kick accent: full brightness in the first frames, then the ring leaves the frame and the spikes fade out by one second. Fire Play from a Macro on the beat with Hide on Stop, in Additive over whatever runs underneath. Centred, so it suits a round or central Surface best.

items.name: Confetti Cannon
items.description: Three cannons along the bottom edge fire white confetti that spreads across the frame and falls away.
items.notes: A three-second celebratory hit: the bursts start at the bottom, fill the upper frame by one second and settle down and out by three. Use it on the drop or the end of a set, in Additive over a Loop. It lights much of the frame for a while, so leave room before firing it again.

items.name: Cube Shatter
items.description: A grey cube appears and bursts in a flash into smaller cubes that tumble outward and fade.
items.notes: A short 3D hit: the cube breaks at about a quarter second with a bloom flash and the pieces drift for a second before fading. It reads on a single central Surface, or on a box-shaped object mapped with several Surfaces. Fire it on a snare or a fill, over a dark Loop such as Nested Cubes.

items.name: Firework Burst
items.description: One firework bursts in the centre, then two smaller ones beside it, and the sparks drift down and fade.
items.notes: A three-second hit with a staggered start: centre burst, then the side bursts a quarter second later, all gone by two and a half seconds. Use it for a peak moment or a breakdown ending, in Additive over a dark Scene. It has fine detail, so it reads best on a large Surface.

items.name: Flash Cut
items.description: The frame flashes white with a black slit across the middle that widens as the white fades out.
items.notes: A hard white flash that lights the whole Surface for a few frames and closes in from a horizontal cut, gone in about 0.7 seconds. One of the brightest hits in the set: use it on a kick or a cut between Scenes. In Additive it brightens everything below it; on its own it works as a blinder.

items.name: Frame Flash
items.description: A full white frame that collapses to a horizontal band and then a thin line, all within a third of a second.
items.notes: The shortest hit in the set: one white frame, then a band that narrows to nothing by 0.3 seconds. Use it for hi-hats, stabs or fast repeated triggers where a longer tail would smear. Retriggers cleanly because Play while playing restarts it.

items.name: Frame Shatter
items.description: A white pane cracks from the centre like glass and shatters into shards that fly out and vanish.
items.notes: A bright, detailed hit: the frame goes white with a spider-web crack, then breaks into shards flying toward the viewer, gone by one second. Use it on a big drop or a transition to a new Scene. It fills the whole Surface, so it covers what runs below while it lasts.

items.name: Inversion Slam
items.description: The frame turns white, then a black disc grows from the centre and swallows the white.
items.notes: A graphic, very bright hit: white for about 0.15 seconds, then a black circle expands until the frame is black at 0.5 seconds. Use it on a kick or a clap where the lights should slam and clear. It reads on any Surface shape; on a round Surface the disc matches the edge.

items.name: Light Burst
items.description: A stage of tall light pillars flares from a blinding central lamp that shrinks back to two small lights.
items.notes: A lighting-rig hit: the central flare peaks around a third of a second and recedes, with the pillars and floor fading out by one second. Suits a stage backdrop or a wide Surface. Fire it on the downbeat over Pillar Corridor or Beam Scan to make the rig feel like it reacts.

items.name: Shockwave Ring
items.description: A thick white ring expands from the centre past the edges, leaving a faint polar grid that fades.
items.notes: A clean, geometric hit: the ring reaches the edges in half a second and the grid of rings and spokes it leaves fades by 1.2 seconds. Good on kicks, over a Loop in Additive. Centred, so it suits round or square Surfaces; on a wide Surface Fit Cover keeps the ring round.

items.name: Shockwave Slam
items.description: A bright core and a sphere of radial streaks expand past the frame, leaving a small glow that fades.
items.notes: A heavier variant of Shockwave Ring: bright streaks burst outward and the frame darkens to a single glowing dot by one second, with a tail to two seconds. Use it on a drop or a big kick. Leave a beat or two before firing it again so the tail can clear.

items.name: Strobe Burst
items.description: Horizontal white bars flicker across the frame in a burst and decay to faint grey streaks.
items.notes: A barcode-like strobe hit: bright bars for the first frames, then fewer and dimmer bars sliding sideways until one second. Use it for snare rolls or glitchy accents. It lights the whole Surface, so it pairs with Glitch Stutter or with the Block Glitch and Slice Shift Filters.

items.name: Wall Burst
items.description: A wall of blocks is blown through from behind by a light, and the blocks tumble toward the viewer.
items.notes: A 3D hit with a flicker: the wall breaks at about a quarter second, goes black for a few frames, then the lit blocks fall and the scene fades by two seconds. Use it on a big drop. It lights a wide area, so it works as the only Layer while it plays.

items.name: Laser Fan Sweep
items.description: Three laser emitters on the bottom edge fan thin beams upward that sweep and cross.
items.notes: Reads as a laser rig: fans from the left, centre and right corners of the bottom edge open, close and cross in a steady rhythm, and the loop opens with the centre fan snapping shut. Lots of thin lines, so it reads best on a large Surface. Use it for high-energy sections; Chromatic Aberration or Scanlines over it add texture.

items.name: Monolith Sweep
items.description: A tall slab stands in a pool of light while the light circles it and its shadow sweeps across the floor.
items.notes: Slow and sculptural: the monolith's faces brighten and darken as the light orbits, and the shadow turns around it. It sits in the centre of the frame, so it suits a tall central Surface or a real object. Use it for intros and breakdowns, under slow Hits.

items.name: Nested Cubes
items.description: Wireframe cubes nested inside one another rotate, with glints running along their edges.
items.notes: A solid 3D loop: the outer cube tilts and turns while the inner cubes flash on the accents. It reads well mapped onto a real box or a central Surface. Pairs with Cube Shatter as a Hit, and with Punch Zoom on the beat.

items.name: Particle Stream Rise
items.description: A field of small white particles drifts steadily upward across the whole frame.
items.notes: A low-light texture: fine points rise at a constant speed with no cuts or accents. It suits any Surface shape as a background Layer. Stack it in Additive under brighter Loops to keep dark areas alive, or use it alone in quiet passages.

items.name: Pillar Corridor
items.description: A corridor of tall pillars lit from above, with the viewer moving slowly forward between them.
items.notes: Architectural and fairly bright: pillars on both sides catch light from lamps overhead, pulsing brighter on the accents. It suits a wide wall or a stage backdrop. Pair it with Light Burst on the drop, or put Beam Scan in Additive above it.

items.name: Radar Sweep
items.description: A circular radar scope with range rings, where a sweeping line and its fading trail light up blips.
items.notes: A steady, low-light loop: the arm turns clockwise at a constant speed and blips glow as it passes. The scope is a circle in the centre of the frame, so a round Surface with Fit Contain shows it whole. Good for tense or technical sections, with Scanlines or Dither over it.

items.name: Ray Wheel
items.description: A starburst of white rays from the centre turns slowly and fills the frame, with a ring pulsing outward now and then.
items.notes: Bright and full-frame: dozens of rays rotate around a hot centre and a faint ring expands on the accents. It lights most of the Surface, so use it as a base Layer for peaks, or at low opacity under Hits. Wave Distortion or Chromatic Aberration over it bend the rays.

items.name: Ring Pulse
items.description: Concentric white rings pulse outward from a dot in the centre, a thick ring on each accent.
items.notes: A clean, rhythmic loop: thin rings drift outward and a bold one expands on each beat. Centred, so it suits round Surfaces, speakers or domes. Use it in steady grooves; Shockwave Ring on the drop continues its language.

items.name: Slab Ring
items.description: A ring of vertical slabs around a central light opens and tilts apart, casting shafts outward.
items.notes: 3D and fairly bright: the slabs close into a ring and burst open on the accents, with light spilling between them. It sits in the centre of the frame. Use it for driving sections, over a dark Scene, or under Light Burst on the drop.

items.name: Slat Shafts
items.description: Light falls through angled window slats in soft shafts, throwing slat shapes onto the floor.
items.notes: Moody and low-light: the slats turn and the shafts and floor patches shift and swell slowly. It reads like a lit room, so it suits a backdrop or a wall. Use it for intros or breakdowns, with Particle Stream Rise in Additive for dust in the air.

items.name: Square Heartbeat
items.description: A tunnel of nested square frames rotates, thickening and brightening in a double pulse like a heartbeat.
items.notes: Full-frame and graphic: square outlines fill the whole Surface, and the loop opens on its brightest pulse. It works as a base Layer in driving sections. On square or rectangular Surfaces the outer frames follow the edges.

items.name: Square Snap
items.description: A single white square outline snaps between square and diamond on the beat.
items.notes: The most minimal loop in the set: one outline in the centre rotating 45 degrees in sharp snaps. It keeps a Surface's shape readable and uses little light. Put copies on several small Surfaces for a rig look, or stack it over a dark texture such as Particle Stream Rise.

items.name: Star Flare
items.description: A four-point white star snaps between sizes and orientations, opening on a huge flare.
items.notes: Graphic and punchy: a star alternates between upright and diagonal and small and large on the beats, and the loop starts with a flare that crosses the frame. Start it on a downbeat. Good on small or central Surfaces, or in Additive over a textured Loop.

items.name: Strobe Grid Sequencer
items.description: A 16×9 grid of tiles flashes in sequenced patterns: blocks, columns, rows, checkerboards and full-grid hits.
items.notes: A tile sequencer that changes pattern on the beat and ends each pass on a full-grid flash, so it can be very bright. Map it onto an LED-wall-like Surface or a grid of real panels. Use it for peaks; Tile Scramble or Pixel Crush over it push it further.

items.name: Sub Terrain Warp
items.description: A wireframe landscape in perspective, with a ring-shaped wave rising from the centre and rolling outward.
items.notes: A bass-reactive feel without audio: a grid floor fills the lower two thirds and a ripple lifts and travels outward twice per loop. It suits a wide Surface or a floor projection. Use it in drops with a heavy low end; Wave Distortion over it deepens the warp.

items.name: Tunnel Grid
items.description: A wireframe square tunnel twists and rotates, with outlines that flare white on the accents.
items.notes: A classic tunnel: grey grid lines recede to the centre while the tunnel turns, and single frames flare bright on the beat. Full-frame, so it suits large Surfaces and domes. Use it for driving sections; Frame Tunnel is a softer alternative.

items.name: Wire Polyhedron
items.description: A glowing wireframe icosahedron turns in the centre of the frame, its edges flaring on the accents.
items.notes: A single 3D object with a steady rotation and bloom on the edges nearest the light. It sits in the centre, so it suits a central Surface or a real object. Pair it with Nested Cubes or Cube Shatter, or put it in Additive over a dark texture.
